title: Design System: Mohanad Yehia Software QA Portfolio

display-closing.purpose: The shared closing title on every page.

display-page.purpose: The h1 of the work archive and each case study.

chapter.purpose: Chapter titles: experience, approach, archive page sections, not found.

evidence-headline.purpose: Heading inside the case-study evidence panel.

row-title.purpose: Title of a row that leads somewhere.

company.purpose: Employer names in the roles list.

claim.purpose: The one-sentence claim under each project title.

address.purpose: The email address in the closing.

figures.purpose: The Blue Ribbon sentence that carries the four figures.

result-figure.purpose: Measured values in the LLM evidence panel.

subtitle.purpose: Role names and the bold line of a figure caption.

serif-voice.purpose: Italic, amber. One emphasised word or phrase in a heading, and the Blue Ribbon figures.

body-reading.purpose: Case-study prose, role summaries, approach descriptions.

nav.purpose: Chrome navigation, the Resume button, highlight lists, evidence notes.

note.purpose: Descriptor lines, periods, scope notes, definition labels, captions of tables.

caption.purpose: Hero hint and status, scope line, loader note, checked date.

code.purpose: Inline code in captions and case-study prose.

shadows.name: chrome-hairline
shadows.purpose: A one-pixel rule under the chrome when it returns as a solid bar over reading-page content. The only box-shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for entrances, the chrome, the menu wipe, and view transitions (--ease-out).

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Colour, background, and border changes on hover and state.

motion.name: nudge
motion.purpose: Icon movement on hover: 4px on text links, .5rem on lead rows.

motion.name: chrome-slide
motion.purpose: The chrome sliding away and back.

motion.name: menu-wipe
motion.purpose: The circular wipe of the narrow-screen menu; links follow at .05s steps.

motion.name: stage-fade
motion.purpose: The stage canvas fading in after its first frame, and the still fading out on phones.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Page changes, with the project title travelling between pages.

motion.name: scroll-scrub
motion.purpose: Scroll-driven stage and held chapters use no easing; entrances use eased tweens of about .9s.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Compact gutter; history and strategy table restack.

breakpoints.name: reading-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Reading-page compact type; framework rows stack.

breakpoints.name: reading-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Reading-page opening and case reading grid collapse to one column.

breakpoints.name: stage-wide
breakpoints.purpose: At and above: held chapters, full chrome. Below (max-width 1023px), or on coarse pointers: flowing chapters, menu button, still until first frame.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The main action of a first screen. Used once, in the hero.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.4rem; border-radius: .6rem; font: 600 1rem/1.65 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-action--primary { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #ffd17d, #f4a938); color: #17110a; } .ds-action--primary:hover { background: #ffda98; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Quiet Action
components.description: The secondary action beside the primary one.
components.css: .ds-action-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.4rem; border-radius: .6rem; border: 1px solid #b1a492; background: #19171470; color: var(--color-ink); font: 600 1rem/1.65 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-action-quiet:hover { background: #393027; } .ds-action-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Chrome Resume Button
components.description: The flat amber Resume download in the chrome on wide screens.
components.css: .ds-chrome-resume { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.15rem; border-radius: .6rem; background: var(--color-amber); color: var(--paper-ink); font: 600 .95rem/1.65 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s; } .ds-chrome-resume:hover { background: #ffda98; } .ds-chrome-resume:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Link

components.html: Read the case study Open dashboard
components.css: .ds-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem 2rem; } .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; min-height: 44px; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; color: var(--color-ink); font: 600 1rem/1.65 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-text-link--quiet { color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-text-link:hover { color: var(--color-amber); } .ds-text-link svg { transition: transform .25s; } .ds-text-link:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-chrome { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(1.25rem, 2.4vw, 2.6rem); height: 4.5rem; color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-graphite); padding: 0 1.25rem; } .ds-chrome a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-chrome-brand { margin-right: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font: 700 1.15rem/1.65 'Alexandria Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-chrome-nav { display: flex; gap: clamp(1.25rem, 2.4vw, 2.6rem); font: 400 .95rem/1.65 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-chrome-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; } .ds-chrome-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: .55rem; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-chrome-nav a:hover::after, .ds-chrome-nav a:focus-visible::after, .ds-chrome-nav a[aria-current]::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-chrome-nav a[aria-current] { color: var(--color-amber); } .ds-chrome a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Lead Row
components.description: A ruled row that leads to a case study. The title carries it and the arrow answers the pointer.
components.html: TestPulseQA reporting and flaky-test analysis
components.css: .ds-lead-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 1.5rem; align-items: center; padding-block: clamp(1.6rem, 2.6vw, 2.6rem); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-lead-row > svg { width: clamp(1.75rem, 2.6vw, 2.6rem); height: clamp(1.75rem, 2.6vw, 2.6rem); transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-lead-row:hover > svg, .ds-lead-row:focus-visible > svg { transform: translateX(.5rem); } .ds-lead-title { display: block; font: 700 clamp(1.7rem, 3.6vw, 4rem)/1.04 'Alexandria Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; transition: color .25s; } .ds-lead-row:hover .ds-lead-title, .ds-lead-row:focus-visible .ds-lead-title { color: var(--color-amber); } .ds-lead-kind { display: block; margin-top: .9rem; font: 400 .9rem/1.65 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; color: var(--color-amber); } .ds-lead-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-evidence { position: relative; padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 4rem); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--body-copy); font: 400 1rem/1.65 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-rule { position: absolute; inset: -1px -1px auto; height: 2px; background: var(--color-amber); } .ds-evidence h2 { max-width: 18ch; margin: 0 0 clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2.6rem); font: 700 clamp(1.9rem, 3.6vw, 4rem)/1.04 'Alexandria Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-evidence h2 em { font-family: 'Bodoni Moda Variable', 'Bodoni 72', Didot, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--color-amber); } .ds-results { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; margin: 0; } .ds-results > div { padding-top: 1.1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-results dt { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-results dd { margin: .5rem 0 0; font: 600 clamp(2.4rem, 4.4vw, 5rem)/1 'Alexandria Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; color: var(--color-amber); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-evidence-note { margin: 1.5rem 0 0; font-size: .95rem; max-width: 70ch; color: var(--color-muted); }

components.name: Filter Option

components.css: .ds-filter { border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 2rem; font: 400 1rem/1.65 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-filter-option { position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-option input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-filter-option > span { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding-block: .5rem; color: var(--color-muted); transition: color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-filter-option:hover > span { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-filter-option input:checked + span { color: var(--color-amber); border-color: var(--color-amber); } .ds-filter-option input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-filter-count { margin-left: .4rem; font-size: .75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
One live object stands for the system under test. On the homepage it is a real-time WebGL stage of dark chrome and amber glass, fixed behind the document; the cursor inspects it and scrolling turns it into each body of evidence. Everything written sits in HTML in front of it, on graphite, in warm white. The reading pages (work archive, case studies, not found) keep the same chrome, heading voice, and closing without the stage, and carry a still plate of the object beside their opening.

The system is dark from end to end. Every chapter stays on graphite; the owner withdrew a paper-coloured chapter and an amber-coloured chapter, so there is no light or saturated field anywhere. Amber is an accent: the emphasised word in a heading, the Blue Ribbon figures, thin rules, hover and current states, and the primary action. Type carries the hierarchy with two sans families and one serif italic used as a second headline voice. Surfaces are square and flat, separated by one-pixel rules; depth belongs to the object.

The homepage holds (pins) its chapters on wide screens while the stage fits, and flows on narrow screens. Phones show a still until the first drawn frame. Reduced motion, no JavaScript, and no WebGL2 keep the full page with the still.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite field on every page and chapter, warm white type, amber as accent only.
Alexandria for display, Manrope for text, Bodoni Moda italic for one emphasised word or phrase per heading and for the Blue Ribbon figures.
One chapter scale for chapter titles; only the hero, project titles, and the closing are larger.
Square, flat DOM surfaces separated by one-pixel warm rules. The two rounded shapes are the action corner and the circular lens.
A fixed live stage behind the homepage document; a still plate of the object on reading pages.
Twelve-column chapters with copy on one side and the object or the evidence on the other.
Complete content without motion, scripts, or WebGL2.

rules.name: The Graphite Throughout Rule
rules.body: Every chapter and every page sits on Graphite. No light field and no saturated field. The only tonal lift is Raised Graphite on the evidence panel.

rules.name: The Amber Is An Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber marks emphasis, figures, rules, state, and the primary action. It never becomes a section ground.

rules.name: The Words With The Colour Rule
rules.body: A result is never carried by colour alone. Recorded Failure always arrives with its word and scope.

rules.name: The One Chapter Scale Rule
rules.body: Chapter titles use `typography.chapter`. Only the hero, the project titles, and the closing are larger. The owner rejected oversized chapter type.

rules.name: The One Serif Phrase Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda italic marks one emphasised word or phrase in a heading, and the Blue Ribbon figures. It never sets running text; emphasis inside paragraphs stays ordinary.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Tables, definition values, run identifiers, periods, counts, and the clock use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Held Or Flowing Rule
rules.body: A chapter holds only on wide screens with motion allowed and the stage running. Everywhere else it flows as ordinary document content, with nothing hidden.

rules.name: The Complete Still Rule
rules.body: The full page reads with the still image of the object when motion is reduced, scripts are off, or WebGL2 is missing. Phones show the still until the stage has drawn its first frame.

rules.name: The Depth Belongs To The Object Rule
rules.body: Glass, chrome, glow, and bloom live in the stage and in its still plates. HTML surfaces stay flat and are separated by rules and tone.

dos: **Do** keep every chapter and page on Graphite (`colors.graphite`) with Warm White text.
**Do** use Amber for emphasis words, figures, thin rules, hover and current states, focus, and the primary action.
**Do** set chapter titles at `typography.chapter`, weight 700, and reserve larger type for the hero, project titles, and the closing.
**Do** mark one word or phrase per heading with the Bodoni Moda italic voice in Amber.
**Do** separate content with one-pixel Warm Rule lines and keep panels square.
**Do** give copy one side of a chapter and the object or the evidence the other.
**Do** state the scope beside every figure, and pair Recorded Failure with a word.
**Do** keep interactive targets at 44px or taller with the two-pixel Amber focus outline.
**Do** keep the page complete with the still when motion is reduced, scripts are off, or WebGL2 is missing.
donts: **Don't** introduce a light or saturated chapter field. The owner withdrew the paper-coloured and the amber-coloured chapters.
**Don't** oversize chapter titles. The owner rejected chapter type above the chapter scale.
**Don't** set running text or paragraph emphasis in the serif italic.
**Don't** add drop shadows or rounded panels to HTML surfaces.
**Don't** carry a result by colour alone.
**Don't** treat the legacy study page (`src/pages/experience.astro` and its layout) as a reference for new surfaces.
